producer_report.summary: I raised producer_timeout_s in athena.toml from 1800 to 3000 and added decision D124 to docs/decisions.md. D124 names the five failed jobs, says the sixth is unnamed, and gives the build-time claim as reported. It lists splitting jobs, a faster suite and keeping work on timeout as queued alternatives, and gives the reversal steps and a proposed signal. I also added a bullet under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md. No code or other budget values changed, and clippy is clean. I could not read the full `cargo test --locked` output, so I did not see its pass count. Only the decision-log guard test, run alone, is confirmed passing.
